atDirectives.name: @theme
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4 — define/override CSS custom properties (theme tokens) such as colors, spacing, radius, fonts, shadows, and animations. Use `@theme inline { ... }` to in-place override without wrapping variables.

atDirectives.name: @utility
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4 — registers a new utility class directly in CSS. The selector can use nesting (`&:hover`, `&[data-foo]`) and references any CSS property.

atDirectives.name: @custom-variant
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4 — defines a custom variant selector (e.g. `@custom-variant dark (&:is(.dark *));`) which can then be composed like `dark:bg-slate-900`.

atDirectives.name: @source
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4 — tells the Vite/PostCSS plugin where to scan for class names (content sources). Replaces the legacy `content` config key.

atDirectives.name: @import
atDirectives.description: Standard CSS @import; in Tailwind v4 used as `@import "tailwindcss";` to bootstrap the framework, and `@import "tailwindcss/utilities";` for layer-specific imports.
